item.title: Wet and warm spring with several severe weather events ahead
item.description: Missouri has started the spring season with rainfall totals just under 2" above normal for the first three weeks of March. This wet weather has erased the rain deficit recorded during a drier than normal winter. The Climate Prediction Center expects the warming trend to continue, forecasting a warmer than normal spring for the region.
